pr_title: executor: return error for GRANT ALL ON performance_schema.*
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: unconsolable <chenzhipeng2012@gmail.com>

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #27867

### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed:

Return `ErrDBaccessDenied` when dbName is `performance_schema` and priv is `AllPriv` in func `grantDBLevel`

### Release note

```release-note
GRANT ALL ON performance_schema.* will error as follows instead of succeeding:
ERROR 1044 (42000): Access denied for user 'root'@'%' to database 'performance_schema'
```

issue_context.title: GRANT ALL ON performance_schema.* succeeds
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

```sql
create user u1;
grant all on performance_schema.* to u1;
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

Error:
```sql
mysql> create user u1;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0,03 sec)

mysql> grant all on performance_schema.* to u1;
ERROR 1044 (42000): Access denied for user 'root'@'localhost' to database 'performance_schema'
```

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

Success
```sql
tidb> create user u1;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0,01 sec)

tidb> grant all on performance_schema.* to u1;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0,01 sec)
```

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->

comments:
More info on MySQL behaviour here:
https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/performance-schema-table-characteristics.html

I don't consider it to be a serious bug, just a minor MySQL incompatibility (and extending the GRANTS rather than limiting them).
TiDB will check the previliage when execute the sql with performance_schema.* table. So the `grant all` will not effect anything.
Please check whether the issue should be labeled with 'affects-x.y' or 'fixes-x.y.z', and then remove 'needs-more-info' label.
